title: Redraw Nodes Camera Ease Strict Mode
description: Fix one-shot Redraw nodes camera: preserve fixture.camera on layout patch; arm camera RAF ease via nodesRedrawCameraEaseTick state (Strict Mode safe) instead of pending boolean cleared before RAF; layout effect deps only tick; separate effect cancels nodes RAF when cameraDisplayOverrideByPane set; cancel nodes RAF on play start and post-play ease start.
summary: Redraw nodes: keep prev fixture camera on WASM layout merge. After patch, bump nodesRedrawCameraEaseTick so a useLayoutEffect (deps only that tick) eases boardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline from the pre-commit shell cameras toward triptychCamerasFromFixture(fixtureRef) over 1.8s (hold first third). Avoids Strict Mode killing the ease by not using a boolean cleared before RAF. Separate useEffect cancels nodes RAF when display override is active; play start and post-play ease still cancel nodes RAF.
